      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Raising the baseline toolchain to C++23 is a strategic compiler and dependency transition that affects all build platforms and contributor environments. It enables modern language idioms and removes accumulated build workarounds across the repository."
    },

      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release notes that merely document code changes do not qualify for the documentation category."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/txospenderindex.cpp solely for mechanical C++23 modernization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates of container methods that follow from the standard bump do not alter index functionality or architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",

    },
    {

    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches RPC files purely for mechanical modernization to C++23 library utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical changes to RPC source files that leave client-facing commands and interfaces unchanged do not belong in RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes src/test/util_expected_tests.cpp and updates tests across fuzz and unit tests mechanically.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deleting unit tests for removed polyfills and updating tests to follow C++23 syntax does not change testing framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-tx.cpp and contrib/devtools/bitcoin-tidy/CMakeLists.txt mechanically.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Passing through command-line tool files for routine modernization does not alter tool functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies shared utilities in src/util/expected.h, src/compat/byteswap.h, and src/util/types.h to retire in-tree polyfills in favor of standard C++23 types.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retiring in-tree polyfills like `util::Expected` for `std::expected` and standard byteswap simplifies core utility headers and reduces custom boilerplate. While beneficial for long-term maintenance, it is an internal developer cleanup that can be deferred without user-facing consequence."
    },
